verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents an On-premise, self-hosted edition for organizations that need to manage their own data, including running it in their own PCI or HIPAA compliant environments. That gives customers real control over where their data lives. The evidence shows no region or residency choice for the hosted SaaS service, so data location is only controllable by running the product yourself. Missing for 10: selectable hosted data regions (e.g. EU/US), documentation of residency guarantees, independent corroboration of the on-premise deployment.
